answer_1.quote: Correctly ordering sentences has applications for summarization, constructing natural language explanations, automatic scoring of an essay, and automatic generation and evaluation of a narrative.

answer_2.quote: We employ the following five metrics to evaluate our approach. For all these metrics, a higher value corresponds to better performance. Perfect Match Ratio (PMR) ... Sentence Accuracy (ACC) ... Kendall's Tau (TAU) ... Rouge-S (R-S) ... Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) ...
